title: Kernel build refuses an INSTALLED package page with isDefault on a non-record page (a69a40a572 / #23708): every hosted environment with HotCRM 4.0.1 fails to boot
body:
Filing-gate category ① (a defect with a measured reach) and ③ (a maintainer direct order). Verbatim, 2026-10-16: the option 「两条都做」, which reads "框架立一张 p0 卡（我认领、派云端会话）：内核构建遇到已安装、已存储的旧元数据里被退役的声明时，按过渡窗口只警告、不拒绝启动；发布时照样拒". The maintainer also directed earlier: 「相关任务都提到最高优先级」.

**Reader:** the cloud#2899 executor (the maintainer's local session) claims it and dispatches a cloud developer session today. Downstream, cloud's next pin bump carries the fix (cloud#2868).

**Dedupe** (`gh api search/issues` total_count, closed issues included):
- `MisplacedDefaultPageError`: 2 (#23708, the change itself; #23610, its spec question).
- `isDefault home page refused installed package kernel`: 12.
- `retired declaration installed artifact kernel build refuse transition`: 34.
- None asks for a transition for already-installed packages. The HotCRM-side change is objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2120, shipped in HotCRM 5.0.0.

## What happens
`a69a40a572` (#23708, `feat(spec)!`, merged 2026-10-16 02:00Z) refuses `isDefault: true` on any page that is not a bound record page. The refusal fires when a **kernel builds from an installed package**, not only when a package is authored or published.

HotCRM 4.0.1, the version installed across hosted environments, declares `isDefault: true` on its `type: 'home'` page `sales_home_page`. On cloud's staging at framework `f7e836da1ed3` (it contains `a69a40a572`, because it had to contain objectstack#23843's fix `ae4dfafa15`), every environment with HotCRM 4.0.1 installed fails its kernel build:

```
[KernelManager] kernel build failed {"environmentId":"9930e6cf-…","err":{"name":"MisplacedDefaultPageError","message":"Page \"sales_home_page\" of package \"app.objectstack.hotcrm\": `isDefault: true` is refused on a `type: 'home'` page: it marks the default record page of an object, and nothing reads it on any other …"}}
```

**Reach:**
- **Staging:** 10 of 36 environments have HotCRM 4.0.1 installed, and each one is unserved.
- **Production:** the 5 demo environments hold HotCRM 4.0.1, so production cannot take a framework pin that contains `a69a40a572` until each one is upgraded.
- **Not measured:** environment-authored (AI-built) pages stored in tenant databases with the same shape would fail the same way. Whether any exist was not measured.

**Why the ordering matters:** `a69a40a572` sits before `ae4dfafa15` on `main`, so cloud has no pin that has the remote-ceremony fix without this refusal.

**Workaround in use:** upgrading an environment's HotCRM to 5.0.0, which declares no `isDefault` on its home page. That is per environment and does not cover customer-authored metadata.

## Wanted
An already-installed package or stored metadata item carrying a declaration a newer spec retires must not brick the environment's kernel. The lane picks the mechanism, likely the ADR-0087 transition pattern:
- refuse at authoring, save and publish (unchanged);
- on load of an installed or stored item, drop or ignore the retired declaration with a named warning (`MisplacedDefaultPageError` becomes a load-time advisory), so the kernel builds.

Apply the same review to the other load-time refusals in the same commit (closed template set, regions). If contract-first rules out any load-time tolerance, return `needs_decision` with the alternatives instead of building one.

**Acceptance:**
- a kernel built from HotCRM 4.0.1's published bundle (marketplace `pkgv` of 4.0.1, or the `v4.0.1` tag's `dist/objectstack.json`) boots, with the named warning;
- the same page saved or published through the authoring door is still refused;
- an ablation of the load-time path turns the boot red.

Related: #23708, #23610, objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2120, objectstack-ai/cloud#2868, objectstack-ai/cloud#2899.
